scope: Pinned public/native/scripts.json and public/native/card-data.json; lexical direct creation inventory with limited integer evaluation and explicitly bounded dynamic cases. No Lua interpreter, native duel execution, CDB/WASM mutation, or rule certification.

provenance.copyright: Project Ignis contributors; individual Lua author lines retained

provenance.license: No license declaration found in the pinned upstream repository

method.lexing: Lua short and long comments omitted. Escaped short strings and Lua long bracket strings retained as opaque tokens. Balanced call/table delimiters parse top-level arguments, including nested calls. API name permits arbitrary whitespace between tokens.
method.evaluation: Only integer literals, identifiers with established bindings, unary +/-, binary +/- are evaluated through a restricted AST. No eval/exec is used on Lua expressions. GetID comes from cNNN.lua and is checked in each direct generator script. s.listed_names is recorded/corroborating metadata, not a substitute for a CreateToken call.
method.dynamicCases: Numeric for i domains, Chaos Witch registered-effect label flow, and Scapeghost modulo-4 loop are recorded with source lines. Super Hippo ft requires standard Main Monster Zone semantics; its conditional domain and conservative missing candidate are separate.
limits: This inventories direct API calls and explicit source domains; it does not prove every effect or every iteration is legally reachable.
GetLocationCount native semantics are not implemented by this Lua lexer. No source-only proof claims that code 11050420 can actually be created.

Debug.AddCard in proc_maximum.lua takes caller-supplied card codes. Those calls are generic Maximum setup, with no token-type argument; their arbitrary runtime arguments are not enumerated as token generators.
A CDB alias is recorded as an alias relationship. Aliases are not counted as separate direct Lua call sites.
Token rows with no direct call and no created alias remain explicitly unmapped; descriptions are evidence, not invented native code redirection.
The three TYPE_TOKEN-only rows have no TYPE_MONSTER bit and are not included among playable token monster profiles.

No claims are made about dynamically constructed API names or arbitrary external scripts not contained in the pinned snapshot. All lexical CreateToken identifiers in this snapshot coincide with the parsed direct API calls.
